item.title: Her Goal Was My Birthday: Hotel Executive Turned Coach Lindsy Wnorowski on the Story That Changed Her Life
item.description: Lindsy Wnorowski shares 27-year Marriott journey from 23-year-old GM to regional leader, becoming surrogate mother to cancer patient Haya, and launching Executive Leadership Consulting focused on creating psychological safety and authentic cultures.

item.title: Building the World’s Top Walleye Destination: Gary Moeller’s 35 Years at Ballard’s Resort
item.description: Gary Moeller grew Ballard's Resort from 4 boats to the world's top walleye destination. Hear his 35-year journey of crisis, creativity & growth.

item.title: Kirk Michie on Valuation, EBITDA, and the Trajectory Founders Need to Reach the Exit They Truly Deserve
item.description: Kirk Michie of Candor Advisors shares how he guides founders to better exits after decades in private equity, with $1B+ in closed deals and a mission to level the playing field.

item.title: David Hoffman on Growing a Third Generation Hotel FF&E Company Through Service and Systems
item.description: David Hoffman shares how he grew Furniture Industries 50% through systems and one-stop FF&E service, and why a humbling career lesson transformed his entire approach to leadership and sales.

item.title: Brad Scoffin on Why Baby Boomer Business Owners Are Running Out of Time to Plan Their Exit
item.description: Brad Scoffin of Advanced Business Brokers shares why most business owners are unprepared to sell, how to de-risk and maximize value, and the networking philosophy behind 112,000 trusted connections.

item.title: From High School Dropout to COO and Partner: Layla Ebersole’s Journey at On Call Restaurant Accounting
item.description: Layla Ebersole shares how she went from high school dropout to COO and partner at On Call Restaurant Accounting, growing OCRA to 400 clients by closing books weekly and catching the financial problems operators never see coming.

item.title: Tim Smith on Challenging the Status Quo in Vacation Rental and Why Doing the Right Thing Keeps Paying Off
item.description: Tim Smith shares how he built Casago NSB into a 230-unit operation, survived an internal fraud crisis without losing a single owner, and proved that transparent pricing and flexible cancellations are good business.

item.title: What 10,000 Hours in Restaurants Taught Jason Schofield About Running a Business
item.description: Jason Schofield shares how he went from filing bankruptcy as a restaurateur to building Hive V.O.C, a supply chain company that saves restaurants thousands in unclaimed rebates and brings manufacturing back to the US.

item.title: How Patty Wall Rezoned an Industrial Neighborhood and Launched One of America’s Top Food Halls
item.description: Patty Wall shares how she built Malcolm Yards Market, one of America's top food halls, inside a fire-damaged historic Minneapolis building using RFID technology, short-term chef leases, and a cravability test that set the bar for every concept.

item.title: Danny Bendas on Helping Restaurant Operators Thrive and How Synergy Helps Them Scale
item.description: Danny Bendas shares 35 years of restaurant consulting wisdom at Synergy, from cutting kitchen waste by 50% in Guatemala to surviving cancer while doing client Zoom calls from the infusion chair.
